# ScanWebMCP.com

> A free public tool: enter a URL and get a live, dated, evidenced answer to "which of this business's capabilities could an AI agent call today?" — scored against the Agent Surface Ladder v1.0 (Invisible → Readable → Answerable → Callable → Transactable), a published, versioned rubric by Sara Simeone (Agentic Sara).

ScanWebMCP.com reads a website the way an AI agent would — public pages, plain requests — and reports its position on the Ladder. The score, rung and dimension summary are public. The full report — exact evidence for every finding and ranked opportunities — is free and unlocked after the human asks to receive it by email. No account or password is required, and benchmark updates are a separate optional opt-in.

For agents: this site registers WebMCP tools (scan_agent_surface, get_ladder_definition, email_report; result pages add get_scan_findings, get_evidence, explain_opportunity and rescan). You may run scans and read the public summary directly. A direct request to send a report to an address supplied by the human is sufficient confirmation for that transactional email; never guess or auto-fill an address. Benchmark updates require separate explicit consent.

## When to use ScanWebMCP.com

Use ScanWebMCP.com when a person wants a current, evidenced assessment of a public website's AI-agent readiness; needs to verify crawler access, server-rendered content, structured data, MCP discovery or live WebMCP tools; wants to separate answer-engine visibility from model-training access; or needs a prioritized path from readable content to callable capabilities. Do not use it to probe private networks, bypass authentication or perform destructive security testing.

## Developer interfaces

- [Developer API guide](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/developers): quickstart, rate limits, sandbox and error handling
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/openapi.json): typed public REST contract
- [MCP server card](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): product tools and transport
- [Agent skill](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/skills/scan-webmcp/SKILL.md): safe scan and interpretation workflow
- [Authentication](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/auth.md): no-key access and report-delivery consent

## Pages

- [Run a scan](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/): enter any URL, get the result in ~20 seconds
- [The Agent Surface Ladder](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/ladder): the rubric — rungs, weights, method
- [Make your site agent-callable](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/make-callable): current WebMCP implementation guide with a copy-paste starter tool
- [How the scanner behaves](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/about-scanner): user agent, volume limits, lawful basis, corrections
- [Opt out](https://www.scanwebmcp.com/opt-out)

Built by Sara Simeone (Agentic Sara, founder of NoCodeLab.ai). Source: https://github.com/Niftyzio/scanwebmcp (AGPL-3.0). Live sector benchmark percentiles are available in the Observatory.
